mug_yuki: Previous note (desk_b1 morning) is incorrect. Day 25: kitchen_table_k1 at 09:17. This contradicts the "desk anchor" for early morning. Yuki may start the day in the kitchen or move the mug there before settling at the desk. Check kitchen_table_k1 for early morning queries (08:00-10:00). Re-evaluate desk_b1 for mid-morning (10:00+). Do not default to desk_b1 immediately upon waking.

glass_yuki: New pattern. Day 25: counter_k1 at 16:27. I incorrectly assumed desk_b1 based on general work-hour logic. This suggests Yuki keeps drinking glasses in the kitchen during afternoon breaks, similar to the tablet pattern. Check counter_k1 for afternoon queries (14:00-18:00). Do not assume desk_b1 for drinkware during work hours; kitchen spots are more likely for hydration.

charger_yuki: Previous note (desk_b1 morning) remains relevant. Day 24 evidence (08:46) still holds as no contradicting evidence emerged today. Check desk_b1 for morning queries (08:00-10:00). Re-evaluate coffee_table_l1 for mid-day. Do not assume armchair_l1 without specific late-night evidence.

water_bottle_yuki: Previous note (desk_b1 afternoon) remains relevant. Day 24 evidence (16:13) still holds. Check desk_b1 for afternoon queries (14:00-18:00) as Yuki is at the desk. Coffee_table_l1 may only apply to specific breaks or evenings. Do not default to coffee_table_l1 during work hours.

tablet_yuki: Previous note (counter_k1 late afternoon) remains relevant. Day 24 evidence (17:31) still holds. Check counter_k1 for late afternoon (16:00-18:00). Coffee_table_l1 remains likely for early morning/mid-day. Do not assume coffee_table_l1 during the 17:00 hour.

General Pattern: Yuki’s items track activity, but drinkware (mugs, glasses) has a stronger affinity for kitchen spots (kitchen_table_k1, counter_k1) during transition periods (early morning, afternoon breaks) than previously assumed. Update anchors to prioritize kitchen locations for beverages during these specific windows, rather than defaulting to the desk.
